policy: Editorial selections for the R.I.P. FMV series, independent of FMV classification or eligibility. Seeded from the existing32-game production rotation; quality, ownership and popularity never automatically select or exclude games.

tomcat-alley.reason: Practice a compact beginning, failure montage and verdict; learn to comment while choosing actions.

burning-soldier.reason: Practice explaining a video-background shooter and cutting repeated attempts into an intelligible improvement story.

midnight-raiders.reason: Practice affectionate bad-game comedy, clear failure explanations and an honest finish or stopping point.

wirehead.reason: First substantial branching-movie episode; use a route diagram and preserve the funny wrong turns.

sewer-shark.reason: First major flagship after the practice episodes: a recognizable Sega CD identity, character comedy and a visible learning curve.

the-hive.reason: A PlayStation discovery with filmed briefings and CG action; make the obscurity itself the hook.

supreme-warrior.reason: A deliberate disaster episode; show what the input asks and what the player actually understands.

sherlock-holmes-consulting-detective-vol.reason: First slower investigation: turn witness interviews and deductions into a story without spoiling the answer in the opening.

mad-dog-mccree.reason: First gun/CRT event, contrasting pad play with the intended arcade-style interaction.

psychic-detective.reason: A rare branching discovery with a genuinely different interaction; show one clear route before comparing alternatives.

the-masked-rider-kamen-rider-zo.reason: Lighter camp after two complicated episodes; the footage supplies the spectacle.

dragons-lair.reason: First major classic and Port Problems milestone, after eleven practice productions. Compare clean arcade-style playback with the 3DO and Sega CD interpretations.

crime-patrol.reason: Reuse the now-proven gun setup; explain what changes from Mad Dog rather than repeating its episode.

tender-loving-care.reason: An adult psychological discovery; distinguish the modern presentation from the original profiling behavior.

a-x-101.reason: A deliberate bad-game counterpoint after a quiet story episode.

night-trap.reason: Mid-series surveillance event: Sega CD/32X CD challenge, 3DO comparison and anniversary restoration footage.

road-blaster.reason: A stylish classic after live-action surveillance; compare one matching sequence rather than pausing for an exhaustive port catalog.

the-daedalus-encounter.reason: A substantial 3DO discovery; connect each puzzle to the film situation so the episode stays comprehensible.

slam-city-with-scottie-pippen.reason: The sports-FMV disaster turn changes both subject and rhythm; keep the complete four-disc set ready.

time-gal.reason: A clean animated classic with theatrical failures; explain HD presentation versus the Sega CD English localization.

brain-dead-13.reason: Animated horror discovery; make the pattern-learning visible instead of presenting a random death compilation.

loadstar-the-legend-of-tully-bodine.reason: A camp navigation episode far enough from Sewer Shark to support a useful callback.

d.reason: A contained cinematic classic; record a full uninterrupted attempt before building the edit.

snow-job.reason: A rare discovery earned by an established audience; give its investigation a complete episode arc.

area-51.reason: A recognizable action reset after two longer story productions; show why this conversion feels different from the filmed gun games.

fahrenheit.reason: A discovery built around rescue decisions and timed exploration, with Sega CD/32X CD comparison material.

fox-hunt.reason: A rare camp event; three discs of ambition should produce a focused challenge, not a scene-by-scene recap.

rebel-assault-ii-the-hidden-empire.reason: A recognizable classic to introduce the last arc; separate spectacle from the controls that gate it.

corpse-killer.reason: Camp with a clear version-comparison thesis: modern PC footage plus a 3DO original when useful.

phantasmagoria.reason: The first large Sierra horror production in this sequence; record it as one focused project.

double-switch.reason: Return to the channel’s surveillance roots with a bad-game-friendly challenge and an anniversary comparison.

the-x-files-game.reason: A filmed-mystery finale; use the PS1 four-disc version for the console challenge and research the PC presentation as comparison material.
